# E7 pi0 power — π0

**Task T004; acceptance names this file for W per rail and phase, energy per inference and per step. This is a VERBATIM EXTRACT of `reports/E7_power_energy.md`**: every table keeps its header and only the rows for π0, and every per-configuration section kept is copied whole. Nothing is recomputed, so it cannot disagree with its source. Cross-model prose is NOT copied — it argues about several models at once — so read `reports/E7_power_energy.md` for the commentary, conditions and caveats that apply to these numbers.
